audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart on disk gave Level 6 to 'Skill' while whys[4] and spikes[1] both state Mordekaiser wins the level-6 1v1 outright via Realm of Death.
audit.why: Realm of Death (650 range, 140/120/100s) is a forced isolated duel that also steals stats; Kled's Skaarl health bar is not a second life inside it. The stage owner must be Mordekaiser.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side and win[4] set to Mordekaiser; phases[4].why rewritten to state the 650 range and the stat steal.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[1] and whys[2] awarded Levels 2 and 3 to Mordekaiser in prose while win[1]/win[2] and phases[1]/phases[2] say Kled. Two answers to the same question.
audit.why: Kled's Q Beartrap is 800 range against Obliterate's 675 and Death's Grasp's 700, and his W four-attack burst plus double E resolves faster than Indestructible can stack. The side fields are right; the prose was wrong.
audit.corrected: whys[1] and whys[2] rewritten to explain Kled winning those stages with real ranges/cooldowns.
sources: champ-data/_kits/kled.json (Q 800 range, W autoReset, E 550 double-cast)

audit.why: Spikes already read Lvl 2-3 (Kled burst), Lvl 6 (Realm of Death), 1st item, Late — all four present and matching the kits.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page states the anti-heal interaction: Indestructible (W) converts damage Mordekaiser deals AND takes into a shield he can consume as a heal, so Kled's chip feeds it.
audit.why: Kled's damage pattern is repeated chip (W four attacks, double E), which is exactly the input Indestructible stores. Grievous Wounds timing decides every extended trade.
audit.corrected: wants.you[1] rewritten to buy Executioner's Calling early against Indestructible.
sources: champ-data/_kits/mordekaiser.json (W: 'stores damage he deals and takes to create a shield. He may consume the shield to heal')

audit.whatIsWrong: The kit file tags Mordekaiser's Q (Obliterate) with a 'grounding' flag, but Riot's own description is only 'smashes the ground with his mace dealing damage'. No grounding is described.
audit.why: Derived flags occasionally misfire on tooltip parsing. Asserting that Obliterate grounds Kled's E would be a fabricated mechanic on a live page.
audit.corrected: No claim written either way. Recorded in notes and unverified.

audit.why: Realm of Death at 140/120/100s is correctly identified across tldr, winCon and breakdown.cooldowns as the tracked cooldown.

edits.before: CHAAAARGE turns any side wave into a cross-map gank. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Mordekaiser's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Realm of Death is a 650-range forced duel that steals your stats, and Skaarl is no second life inside it. At 6, fight only with help.

edits.before: His Q-slam already lands the isolated bonus and his W shield blunts your single shotgun volley before your re-E is online.
edits.after: Beartrap reaches 800 to his 675 Obliterate, and W's four fast attacks land before Indestructible has stored enough damage to matter.

edits.before: With E pull plus a ramped W shield he wins the drawn-out trade your level-3 combo can't finish, and his sustain heals your poke.
edits.after: E in, W's four attacks, re-E back out beats him: Death's Grasp is a 16s cooldown at rank 1, so once his pull is spent he cannot hold you.

edits.before: Bait his E pull and W shield, then remount with Skaarl's free health and re-engage
edits.after: Buy Executioner's early — Indestructible heals off your chip unless Grievous cuts it

notes: Mordekaiser's Q (Obliterate) carries a derived 'grounding' flag in the kit file that Riot's own description does not support — no grounding text at all. I did not write any claim about Obliterate stopping Kled's E dash; flagged as unverified. Also note the packet levelChart (Skill/Morde/Morde/Skill/Morde/Morde/Kled) disagrees with what is actually on disk (Skill/Kled/Kled/Skill/Skill/Kled/Kled); I trusted the disk chart plus the 55.02% win rate and changed only Level 6, which the existing prose already conceded to Mordekaiser.
